content:
nina: Kickoff for NexaHealth QBR readout. Proposed date Wed 5/21 9am PT. Need final deck, one-page renewal recommendation, and a short 0s product demo clip. Who volunteers to own the main deck?

own: I can take deck owner duties. Will stitch product metrics + cost trend + onboarding. Need usage window (last 60d) and the playbook adoption numbers.

tara: Ill own enablement: training attendance, completion rates, and two customer success stories to highlight adoption. Request: can someone share the top five support tickets from onboarding?

ben: Ill prep the demo clip (60s) focusing on the most stable flow. If we do live demo, I recommend a short recorded fallback for the heavy model call.

sara: Exec alignment: VP Jordan wants a 10m readout; prefers a clear ask  not more than two options. I can confirm attendance but need the renewal ask language by Tue 5/13.

cs-bot: Reminder: renewal signal flagged (score: 62) and two seats suspended.

nina: Context: onboarding completions are at 72%, playbook runs have tapered, CSAT last survey 3.8/5, comment: "prompts feel inconsistent on complex queries". We need remediation + enablement plan.

own: Noted. Ill include a "what weve done" + "next 30d plan" slide to show immediate remediation (priority routing, short-term token limits).

tara: For enablement, I plan to show: 1) two case studies of successful adoption, 2) a short enablement schedule (office hours + 2 workshops), 3) a one-page playbook summary.

ben: Demo scope confirmed: search -> retrieve -> rerank -> response. Heavy rerank path will be pre-recorded. Live demo will show stable path only.

nina: Draft renewal ask options (first pass):
- Option A: 12mo flex credits + 10% discount + 2 enablement workshops included
- Option B: 6mo pilot renew + expanded support (SLA uplift)
Please comment on preferred framing.

sara: Exec wants a single recommendation. I suggest we lead with Option A and keep B as fallback.

owen: Action items (working):
```
- owen: deck owner  combine usage, onboarding, cost trend (due Fri 5/16)
- tara: enablement slide + 1-pager + 90s clip (due Wed 5/14)
- nina: renewal narrative + recommended ask wording (due Tue 5/13)
- ben: demo clip + fallback recording (due Thu 5/15)
- sara: confirm VP attendance & pre-brief scheduling (due Mon 5/12)
- all: review draft deck in channel by Mon 5/19
```

nina: Also listing the feedback we want from execs: 1) Is the ask compelling? 2) Do remediation steps sufficiently address reliability concerns? 3) Any procurement or compliance blockers?

sara: Ill include those in the pre-brief. VP Jordan requested a 5-slide appendix summarizing the technical mitigation plan; ben can you add a one-slide latency/throughput heatmap?

ben: Yep  will add a latency heatmap and brief note on mitigation (adaptive batching + cache priming).

own: I uploaded a draft health snapshot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/nexa/health (summary pasted below)
own: "Seats: 40 -> 38 (2 suspended), 60d token usage -8%, onboarding completion 72%, CSAT 3.8"

tara: I'll pull support ticket examples for onboarding friction and anonymize them for the deck.

cs-bot: Note: demo environment will have reduced token budget during live demo.

nina: Timeline recap: deck draft due Fri 5/16, enablement assets due Wed 5/14, pre-brief with VP Mon 5/19 3pm PT, final review Tue 5/20 10am PT. Dry run Wed 5/21 8:30am PT.

own: Acknowledged  will post a link to the deck once initial draft done.

sara: Confirmed  Ill chase procurement red flags after pre-brief.

nina: Thanks team  marking action items on the board. Ping here for urgent updates. :white_check_mark:
